title: Gold miners near yearly lows as bullion slides below $3,600
summary: Investing.com -- Gold keeps falling, and the miners are falling with it. Gold Futures (GC) traded at $3,545.95, down 3.79%, as of Nov 20, 10:21 AM EST. That is below the $3,700–$3,800 level one strategist cited when saying miners still generate "tons of cash flow". The same pressures are at work: the 10-year yield is at 4.962%, the Dollar Index is at 103.675, and the Fed is expected to hike in December.
